SELECT c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
FROM debit_card_specializing.customers c
JOIN debit_card_specializing.yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2012'
GROUP BY c.CustomerID
ORDER BY total ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2012'
GROUP BY c.CustomerID
ORDER BY total ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT c.CustomerID
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND substr(y.Date,1,4) = '2012'
GROUP BY c.CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC
LIMIT 1;
